name: R0CKY
tooltip:
R0CKY
2 sec cast
Requires Helms
Tools:
Arclight Spanner
Reagents:
Pile of Junk (80), Neutralized Venom Clot (150), Evercore (150)
Permanently attaches an mechanical compression array to a helmet, allowing you to deploy R0CKY and fall slowly for 2 min. The glider has some initial thrust and allows you to turn while falling.

The helmet can only be used once every three minutes and requires a Midnight Engineering skill of at least 1 to operate.

Fishing: Thalassian Recipe in a Bottle
Recipe: Purchasable on the Auction House
